pages.title: Telecommunications Towers, Poles, Solar & Steel Fabrication Services | Jitrapadu

metadata.description: Telecommunication Structures We design and fabricate telecommunication towers, telecommunication poles, telco poles, radar towers, radio towers, guide masts, rooftop unipoles, smart poles, and billboard poles for urban and industrial deployments. Lighting & High Mast Solutions Our lighting solutions include high mast systems, stadium lights, lamp poles, street lights, signage poles, TNB poles, tiang lampu, tiang jalan, and tiang TNB. Solar & Renewable Structures We provide solar structures, solar parking porches, solar frames, solar poles, lampu solar, tiang solar, and solar street lights for sustainable infrastructure projects. Steel Fabrication & Manufacturing As an experienced pole manufacturer and steel fabricator, we offer steel poles, tiang besi, fabrikasi besi, fabrikasi tiang, and custom pole fabrication services.
